versions.changelog: Declare EVALPAL_API_KEY env var and curl/jq binary requirements in registry metadata

- Initial release of EvalPal skill.
- Run AI agent evaluations via EvalPal directly from chat.
- Trigger evaluation runs, poll for results, and display outcomes in markdown.
- Check status of evaluation runs by ID.
- List all available evaluation definitions across your projects.
- Handles authentication, error cases, and API limits securely.
